title: Reminders: a refresh read that lands after a grant can end the opt-in, so the switch the user just turned on goes off with no words
evidence: From the owner's review of PR 1594. ios/HealthRoadmap/Reminders/ReminderScheduler.swift reschedule reads the record (compute) and then sends read(epoch). Sequence: a refresh reads epoch N and suspends; an erase moves the epoch to N+1; the ask's grant lands as on(N+1); the refresh then lands read(N), and ReminderMode.swift on x read (read != epoch) turns reminders off. Fails safe (off, nothing scheduled). Fix: a refresh-generation token so only the newest read lands, not ignoring older epochs: the record can switch phone and cloud and the epoch can legitimately go down. US-25 AC12b
